description: Inkling 2 Mini (thinkingmachines/Inkling-2-Mini, 26.4B total and 3.4B active looped mixture of experts; NVFP4 experts in layers 0-19, MXFP8 in 20-23) on one DGX Spark through TensorFold's Zig engine (tensorfold-native) as MiaAI-Lab's kit 9e3cf20b builds it: Jürgen Schmied's Inkling 2 Mini CUDA engine (TensorFold PR #4441, commit dc2ca8a1) plus her patches 0001 to 0018 (CUDA drafting with IncoAI's DFlash2 draft model (incoai/Inkling-2-Mini-DFlash2, Apache-2.0, 1 GB, mounted at /models/draft; the checkpoint's own DSpark head stays in the Model), fp8 KV cache, the Inkling reply, reasoning and tool parser, structured output and tool_choice, native CUDA vision for PNG, JPEG and WebP images, prefill tensor cores). The creator publishes no image, so this recipe builds the kit's own image (Zig 0.17.0, xgrammar v0.2.8, libjpeg-turbo 3.1.4.1, libwebp 1.6.0 on NVIDIA's PyTorch 26.07 container) and scans the build for sm_121 kernels. Eight streams, a 262,144-token window, fp8 KV (lossy; bf16 is exact), DFlash2 drafts, image input, fp8 attention projections and tensor-core prefill (both lossy and on in the kit), replies of up to 32,768 tokens without max_tokens, and thinking on by default (the model reasons even at the lowest effort; reasoning_effort is chosen per request). Memory: the declared peak is 93 GiB (99,857,989,632 bytes) = the creator's own start-check use of 71 GiB (scripts/config.sh mem_need_gib at 9e3cf20b: 27 GiB of weights and drafter, 8 streams x 5 GiB of fp8 window, 4 GiB of scratch, 9 GiB reserve) plus the 18.5 GiB prompt cache the creator measured on an idle Spark (the creator's measured steady use is 73.7 GiB). The cache is a floor: the engine sizes it at half the room left over that floor, so a larger room may use more; the engine keeps 9 GiB free when it sizes the pool. Predicted outcome: it is admissible on an idle Spark, but the creator's start check asks for about 80 GiB of MemAvailable at the start, so nothing large should share the Spark. The creator marks that start check, and the settings that follow the engine build, as PROVISIONAL until re-measured; the creator's memory and speed figures are claims until measured here. Licences (information only): the checkpoint is Apache-2.0 with Thinking Machines' Model Acceptable Use Policy; the kit is Apache-2.0 and TensorFold is MIT; the image carries NVIDIA's container terms and the licences of xgrammar, libjpeg-turbo and libwebp.
title: Inkling 2 Mini TensorFold single Spark (Mia)
